rationale.conceptual: The method is standard all-atom MD with a well-known force field, calculating standard metrics (energies, MSD, distances). No novel algorithm or deep domain theory is required; the main challenge is proper system setup and analysis, which aligns with textbook operations slightly extended.
rationale.execution: The pipeline requires building four solution and adsorption systems, running multiple MD simulations, and performing analyses across several stages. This involves 4-6 distinct steps with external tooling (GROMACS, analysis scripts), making it a non-trivial but well-defined multi-stage workflow.

difficulty.reasoning: The task involves setting up and running standard molecular dynamics simulations and computing common properties (interaction energies, diffusion coefficients, distances). The pipeline is moderately involved but the actual work is straightforward MD system building and analysis. Resource needs are minimal given the tiny system size.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Each system has only ~2000 water molecules, one amino acid, and a two-layer gold slab; 3 ns NVT simulation runs comfortably on a single CPU core in minutes, with negligible data volumes.
